svg.aria-label: Bar chart of goose senses. Eyes, the longest bar: they see fine detail 2.5 to 3 times farther than you, 80 percent. Ears, a middle bar: best at 1 to 4 kilohertz, the range of a human voice, 80 percent. Nose, a short bar: weak and used for food, not for hunters, a Tip.
svg.text: A goose lives through its eyes
Detail 2.5 to 3 times farther than you (80%)
Best at 1 to 4 kHz, like your voice (80%)
Weak; used for food, not hunters (Tip)
